title: Hoi An, Quang Nam — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hoi An, Quang Nam: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hoi An is a city in Quang Nam with a population of 120,000. A UNESCO World Heritage ancient town with beautifully preserved architecture, lantern-lit streets, and a thriving expat community drawn to its charm and affordable lifestyle. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
